title: The Cold Extraction
author: Ansel Amberdale
blurb: Marguerite Delacroix, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
